Rights and removal

Other people’s work
stays theirs.

This catalogue studies and describes visual design. It does not own, license, or endorse the works it references.

This is a general notice. Each reference page records its own source, rights tier, and license when known. This page will become more specific as the catalogue grows.

Ownership

Websites, products, printed works, objects, images, typefaces, names, and trademarks shown or described here belong to their owners. A reference in this catalogue does not mean that the owner is affiliated with it, approves of it, or agrees with its notes. Style names and placements are interpretations by the catalogue unless a page says otherwise.

Why images appear here

Screenshots and images identify the work under discussion and support commentary, research, and teaching about design. Each one is credited, dated, and linked to its source where a source exists. Screenshots are kept at a modest size. The catalogue grants no license to any third-party material. To use a work, get permission from its owner or rely on the license the owner gives.

Rights tiers

Tier A
Open license or public domain, as stated by the source, for example CC0 museum images. The image is stored here with its license.
Tier C
A third-party work that may be in copyright, captured or copied for commentary. The image is stored with credit and a link to its source. No license is claimed.
Tier D
Link and metadata only. No image is stored, because the source’s terms do not allow it or the rights are unclear.

A license recorded as unverified means that nobody has confirmed the rights. Treat such material as all rights reserved.

Measurements and tokens

Measured values such as colors, sizes, and font names describe what a source showed on the capture date. Design tokens and implementations in this catalogue are new work that describes a general style. They do not copy any single source. Fonts named in tokens keep their own licenses.

Accuracy

Websites and products change, and interpretations can be wrong. Every reference has a review date. Placements marked as agent-proposed have not been reviewed by a person.

This catalogue’s own content

A license for the catalogue’s own text, data, tokens, and code has not been chosen yet. Until one is published here, ask before you reuse them.

Removal requests

If you own a work referenced here and want it corrected, credited differently, or removed, contact the catalogue maintainer. The catalogue will remove a stored image promptly on a reasonable request and will keep a record of the change.

A contact address for requests will be published here before the catalogue is made public.
